subject: Requisition shelf & priority curation — Q3 headcount cutoffs
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Requisition shelf & priority curation — Q3 headcount cutoffs

Team,

As we lock in Q3 planning for the QBR, we need a short, executable policy to reduce hiring churn and focus limited headcount on mission-critical work. Effective immediately:

- Requisition shelf: all new non-executive requisitions are placed on a 30-day shelf for prioritization unless explicitly approved by the Hiring Committee.
- Priority curation criteria (attached): customer-impact, revenue enablement, regulatory/compliance risk, and critical continuity/backfill.
- Exceptions: Hiring Committee exceptions can be requested with a 1-page justification and an EM + VP sign-off.

Please review the attached "requisition-shelf-criteria.pdf" and the Q3 headcount model I dropped into the Drive link. I need a list of any reqs you believe should be exempted by EOD Thursday (2027-06-24). Include the role, hiring manager, justification, and whether a contractor or internal transfer is a feasible stop-gap.

Quick asks:
- Markus: can you summarize cross-functional backfills that you think meet the "continuity" bar?
- Vanessa: can Recruiting give us pipeline counts for the next 60 days so the committee can weigh risk vs. cost?

Rationale: we have a few open reqs where the business case has shifted and we need to preserve runway while protecting delivery on critical milestones. This is not a freeze on backfills that meet continuity or compliance needs — it's a focused curation effort.

Thanks,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

----
Attachment: requisition-shelf-criteria.pdf (1 page)
Attachment: Q3-headcount-model.xlsx (tabbed)

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Requisition shelf & priority curation — Q3 headcount cutoffs

Thanks, Soojin — this is the right move. A couple of clarifying points: 

1) Cross-functional backfills: I have ~5 roles (engineering infra, reliability, two SREs, and one infra PM) where loss of headcount materially increases delivery risk. I'll send a short justification doc for each by EOD Wednesday.

2) Contractor-to-perm conversions: For our teams with active contractor conversions in process, can the committee treat those as operational continuity and allow exceptions where there is an accepted offer or a critical skill gap? Converting a contractor has a different cost profile and I want that to be considered.

3) Timing: 30 days on the shelf makes sense, but can we add an automatic renewal step for compelling cases (renewal requires a VP note)?

I'll collate the continuity cases and tag them with urgency.

—Markus
Markus Klein
Head of Infrastructure Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Requisition shelf & priority curation — Q3 headcount cutoffs

Soojin/Markus —

Recruiting can provide the 60-day funnel snapshot by tomorrow afternoon. Preliminary notes:
- We have ~28 active candidates in pipeline for roles that would be considered backfills; roughly 7 are final-stage, but offers are not yet accepted.
- Contractor conversions: 6 contractors are pending conversion paperwork; if the committee treats conversions as continuity, we can accelerate offers for 3 of those within 10 business days.

Operational ask: let's set a recurring 45-minute Hiring Committee slot every Tuesday at 10:00 PT for the next 6 weeks to adjudicate exceptions quickly. I will send a calendar invite once leadership confirms.

I've uploaded the Q3 headcount model with a sensitivity tab (Q3-headcount-model.xlsx) — it shows runway impact if we defer 10/20/30 hires. Please review the sensitivity numbers before the first committee meeting.

-Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Talent Programs
Redwood Inference

Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 13:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Requisition shelf & priority curation — pipeline snapshot and timelines

Hi team,

Attached is a short pipeline summary (we do not attach candidate resumes here; full packet available on request):
- Role summaries: 12 Eng/Infra, 6 Product, 4 Sales Ops, 6 CS/backfill
- Final-stage offers: 7 active (2 have verbal acceptance pending comp alignment)
- Contractor conversions: 6 active; 3 with conversion approvals that can be processed in 7–10 business days.

We recommend the committee prioritize cases with an accepted offer and those tied to SLO/regulatory delivery (we flagged those in the doc). For everything else, treating roles as shelf candidates gives us time to re-evaluate market signals.

Attachment: recruiting-pipeline-60d.pdf (summary)

Best,
TalentOps Recruiting

Note: if you want a live dashboard embed in the committee meeting, we can push the current pipeline view to the shared drive and include an auto-updating tab.

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 17:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Requisition shelf & priority curation — Q3 headcount cutoffs

Thanks all — quick decisions and next steps: 

1) Committee cadence: Tuesdays 10:00 PT starting 2027-06-29, recurring for 6 weeks. Vanessa to send invite.
2) Approved exceptions (to be documented in Jira-REQ-PRIORITY-123):
   - 2 SRE backfills (Markus) — continuity case approved
   - 1 Reg Compliance lead (Laura) — delivery-critical, approved
   - 3 contractor conversions with pending approvals (per TalentOps) — approved to proceed but flagged for cost review
3) All other active new reqs move to the 30-day shelf. Hiring managers should submit a 1-page justification if they want an exception.
4) Deliverables: Recruiting to provide the pipeline PDF and a live dashboard for the first committee meeting. Hiring managers to submit exceptions by EOD 2027-06-24.

I'll coordinate final sign-offs and publish the shelf list to the Drive folder after the first committee meeting. Thanks for moving fast on this — preserves runway while protecting delivery-critical work.

Best,
Soojin
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
